execution_rule: Fetch executable snapshot exactly once with cache:no-store; execute those exact fetched bytes from Blob URLs; never refetch executable JS during boot.
visual_rule: Visual and route-specific media are root-upload-safe and may not block Engine boot. Missing route media must fall back or hold only that route.
service_worker_rule: Identity sentinel only. It must never cache or intercept executable runtime files.
failure_rule: Missing or mismatched executable/core release identity blocks first paint. Missing decorative or route imagery does not sink the Engine.
